description: The developer’s app as its OWN app in the stores, with THEIR developer account (Android now; iOS after). store "google": action "set" { packageName (e.g. com.studio.game; fixed once published), serviceAccountJson (a Play service account with release rights, kept sealed), track? (internal|alpha|beta|production), certs? (the app signing SHA-256 from Play Console → App integrity: the app then opens full screen) }; "build" builds the Android bundle from the app’s page (<slug or id>.neblla.app or its own domain) and uploads it to that track — it runs in the background: call "status" for the result; "remove" forgets the Play credentials (the upload key stays, or Play would refuse the next version). The first version of a new app must exist in Play Console (create the app there first). The credentials are entered by the developer. The actions that only look (status) are in neblla_publish_store_read.

certs.description: SHA-256 fingerprints (AA:BB:…) of the app signing certificate

serviceAccountJson.description: The Play service account key, as the JSON text Google gives
